title: The Symmetry Number Structure about Line-1/2
content: In this paper, we discuss the symmetry number structure about line-1/2 . We find that using the symmetry characters of those structures we can give proofs of the number Conjectures: Goldbach Conjecture、Twins Prime Conjecture and Polignac’s conjecture and the Riemann Hypothesis. In this paper, we also gave concise proofs of the Fermat’ Last Theorem and the 3n+1 conjecture.
